review_scope: Primary read the full first-pass report and independently read the complete generator and browser JavaScript. The first-pass reviewer read all other required files completely.
decision: Keep baseline 3D, temporal No, reasoning/planning Yes and exploration/interface No. The screenshot solver must separate the relevant gravity layer, supports and noise in the projected volume, then choose a defensive/fork move whose rival response changes the next decision. Selecting and confirming a logical column is independent of the changing rendered yaw. Retain the reviewer's L1 planar immediate-win visual 2D and reasoning/planning No exceptions.

rationale_clarifications.visual: The baseline cross_fork's designed winning routes lie in the same y=1 plane; the diagonal changes x and z, not all three axes. The 3D baseline judgment rests on identifying that plane among a multi-layer gravity volume with support/noise occupancy, not a claim that cross_fork itself uses an all-axis line. L1 confines the useful immediate-win decision to the simple planar crossing.
rationale_clarifications.temporal: The preview's logical x/z column and gravity landing are persistent, and the confirmation zone is fixed. Animated camera yaw alone does not require temporal interpretation.

uncertainties: Source-based capability judgments; no screenshot-only gameplay or empirical validation of profile boundaries.
